title: SkillGLoW: Procedural-Family Skill Consolidation for Self-Improving Agents on Long-Horizon Task Streams
abstract: arXiv:2609.02217v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly self-improve by writing and reusing textual skills, kept either as one global document or as a flat pool of per-task entries, though most of the evidence comes from domains with structurally similar tasks. On long-horizon workloads where each task demands a different solution, the two forms fail in opposite ways: the document collapses into generic discipline, while the pool inflates and its entries stay bound to the instance that wrote them. We argue the missing unit of reuse is the solving procedure shared by a cluster of related tasks, and build SkillGLoW (Global-Local Weave) around it: the local skills a task writes from its own execution are aggregated into procedural families and compressed into de-instantiated global priors, while the instance detail they hold is regenerated per task rather than stored; a commit gate admits a prior only when real execution shows it does not degrade the deployed library. Acr

translated_title: SkillGLoW：面向长程任务流上自我改进智能体的程序性族技能整合
translated_abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地通过编写和复用文本技能来实现自我改进，这些技能要么保存在一个全局文档中，要么作为按任务划分的平铺条目池，但大多数证据来自任务结构相似的领域。在长程工作负载中，每个任务需要不同的解决方案，这两种形式以相反的方式失效：全局文档坍缩为泛化的纪律规范，而条目池则不断膨胀且其条目仍然绑定在写出它们的任务实例上。我们认为缺失的复用单元是一组相关任务所共享的求解过程，并围绕它构建了SkillGLoW（Global-Local Weave，全局-局部编织）：任务从自身执行中写下的局部技能被聚合为程序性族，并压缩为去实例化的全局先验，而其中包含的实例细节则按任务重新生成而非存储；提交门控只有在真实执行表明某个先验不会降低已部署技能库性能时才允许其入库。
tldr: SkillGLoW通过将任务局部技能聚合为程序性族并压缩为去实例化的全局先验、按需重新生成实例细节，并借助执行验证的提交门控保证技能库质量，解决了长程任务流上LLM智能体技能复用中全局文档过度泛化与实例条目池膨胀失效的问题。
en_tdlr: SkillGLoW tackles the opposite failure modes of global skill documents (collapsing into generic discipline) and per-task skill pools (bloat and instance-binding) on long-horizon task streams by aggregating local skills into procedural families compressed into de-instantiated global priors, regenerating instance details on demand, and admitting new priors only through an execution-validated commit gate.
